seoTitle: Fulton County Schools Calendar 2025-2026: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Fulton County Schools 2025-2026 calendar with Aug 4 first day, May 21 last day, fall break, Thanksgiving, winter break, spring break, teacher workdays and PDF.
heroSummary: Fulton County Schools begins the 2025-2026 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025. The final student day is Thursday, May 21, 2026. Fall Break runs Oct 13-17, 2025, Winter Break runs Dec 22, 2025-Jan 2, 2026, and Spring Break runs Apr 6-10, 2026.
calendarNotes: Fulton County Schools lists 177 instructional days for 2025-2026, with 88 days in the first semester and 89 days in the second semester. Students start on August 4, 2025 and finish on May 21, 2026. Fall Break is October 13-17, Thanksgiving Break is November 24-28, Winter Break is December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026, and Spring Break is April 6-10, 2026. The calendar separates pre-planning, professional development days, teacher workdays, and student instructional days, which matters for childcare and work planning.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fulton County Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fulton County Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fulton County Schools Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 13 through Friday, October 17, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Fulton County Schools in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026. January 5 is a teacher workday, and students begin the second semester on January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fulton County Schools Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 6 through Friday, April 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the Fulton 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The approved Fulton County Schools 2025-2026 calendar lists 177 instructional days for students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Fulton County Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 21, 2026.

customSections.label: What This Fulton Calendar Means for Families
customSections.content: The 2025-2026 Fulton calendar has fewer than 180 instructional days because the official PDF lists 177 student instructional days. Families should pay close attention to staff-only dates around the start of school, November election timing, and the January return from Winter Break.

rows: This year has a lower instructional-day total than later Fulton calendars.
Use the official PDF for year-specific planning instead of assuming a 180-day schedule.
Students do not return immediately after Winter Break ends.
Plan childcare or supervision for January 5 before the January 6 semester start.
Election timing changes the student routine in early November.
Confirm whether your student has assignments, childcare needs, or campus-specific instructions.
